titles.title: The Intruder
titles.plot: After receiving a heart transplant, an enigmatic loner (Michel Subor) journeys to Tahiti to reconnect with the son he fathered many years earlier.

titles.title: Sisters
titles.plot: An exiled Argentine journalist (Ingrid Rubio) investigates the disappearance of her boyfriend while visiting her sister (Valeria Bertuccelli) in Texas.

titles.title: The Incident
titles.plot: A young couple's sheltered and affluent world is shattered when they decide to neglect the needs of a troubled teenage girl.

titles.title: Dancing Arabs
titles.plot: A young Arab in Israel struggles to find his place and an identity.

titles.title: A First Farewell
titles.plot: Wang Lina's experimental debut explores the sensitivity shared by narrative filmmaking and documenting reality, unveiling poetry from the minutiae of Uighurs' life in Xinjiang like none other. Tailing an endearing boy named Isa in Shaya, her heavenly home village surrounded by textured sand dunes and millennia-old trees, she tugs viewers' heartstrings with a story about treasures in his carefree childhood and how they gradually fade away, as love, home, and personal advancement get weighed against another for this generation of minority children, who must bid many farewells to assimilate into the more widely acknowledged best life.

titles.title: A Tale of Three Sisters
titles.plot: Three young girls are taken from a poor village in central Anatolia and given to affluent foster families.

titles.title: About Scout
titles.plot: Scout (India Ennenga), a 15-year-old Goth girl, embarks on a road trip across Texas with a suicidal man (James Frecheville) to find her little sister.

titles.title: Altiplano
titles.plot: In the Andes, a Belgian doctor and his photojournalist wife become ensnared in a native tribe's struggle with a mining company.

titles.title: Americano
titles.plot: A real estate agent (Mathieu Demy) from Paris arrives in Los Angeles to settle his late mother's estate, but a found photograph sends him on an impromptu journey to Mexico to find a woman named Lola (Salma Hayek).

titles.title: Amour
titles.plot: Retired music teachers Georges (Jean-Louis Trintignant) and Anne (Emmanuelle Riva) have spent their lives devoted to their careers and to each other. Their relationship faces its greatest challenge when Anne suffers a debilitating stroke. Though Georges himself suffers from the aches and infirmities of old age, he bravely ignores his own discomfort to take care of his wife, and is determined to keep his promise to her that she never go back to the hospital.

images.caption: Isabelle Huppert as Eva and Jean-Louis Trintignant as Georges in "Amour."

titles.title: An Elephant Sitting Still
titles.plot: A teenager injures a school bully by accident.

titles.title: Apprentice
titles.plot: Aiman, a 28-year-old Malay correctional officer, is transferred to the territory's top prison. At his new job, he is asked to become an apprentice to Rahim, the facility's executioner. Aiman tells his sister of his new position, and she becomes upset when she realizes their father was actually executed by Rahim. Aiman knew this all along. Aiman must overcome his conscience and a haunted past if he wants to become the next chief executioner.

titles.title: Before I Disappear
titles.plot: A deeply troubled young man (Shawn Christensen) and his precocious niece (Fátima Ptacek) bond during a nighttime odyssey through New York City.

titles.title: Black Men Don't Cheat
titles.plot: A young woman's life is turned upside down when her perfect husband is brutally murdered, and she finds herself in grave danger.

titles.title: Camino
titles.plot: A religious organization interferes with the life of a terminally ill girl (Nerea Camacho).

titles.title: Choked: Paisa Bolta Hai
titles.plot: A bank employee who is struggling to pay the bills finds a secret source of seemingly unlimited cash in her home.

titles.title: Citation
titles.plot: A bright student in Nigeria takes on the academic establishment when she reports a popular professor who tried to rape her.

titles.title: Crossing Over
titles.plot: As an agent with Immigration and Customs Enforcement in Los Angeles, Max Brogan is a daily witness to struggles of those who try to cross U.S. borders in search of a better life. For Brogan and his associates, the impact of immigration goes beyond their jobs and defines their lives. Among many people whose lives intersect with theirs are a Mexican factory worker, a British musician and a Korean teen.

images.caption: Harrison Ford as Max Brogan and Alice Braga as Mireya in "Crossing Over."

titles.title: Custody
titles.plot: A judge presides over a custody case that takes an emotional toll on everybody involved.

titles.title: Dans Paris
titles.plot: After a love affair ends badly, a young Parisian named Paul (Romain Duris) sinks into the same kind of deep depression that led his sister to kill herself. He moves back home with his father (Guy Marchand) and aimless brother Jonathan (Louis Garrel) but refuses to get out of bed. One night, Paul rises from his torpor and makes a fateful visit to the Seine.

titles.title: Entangled
titles.plot: A young French woman living in New York City becomes disconnected from everything until she starts to find her voice.

titles.title: Faith of Our Fathers
titles.plot: During the Vietnam War, two young fathers report for duty. Decades later, their sons meet for the first time before traveling to the Vietnam Veterans Memorial in Washington, D.C.

titles.title: Falling Overnight
titles.plot: The day before risky surgery to remove a brain tumor, a young man (Parker Croft) meets a vivacious photographer (Emilia Zoryan) who takes him on an exciting journey through their city.

titles.title: Frankie & Alice
titles.plot: A therapist (Stellan Skarsgard) treats a black stripper (Halle Berry) who has multiple personality disorder, including that of an imperious white racist.

titles.title: Free in Deed
titles.plot: A man tries to perform a miracle when a young mother brings her son in to get healed.

titles.title: Frontier of Dawn
titles.plot: A photographer (Louis Garrel) has an affair with a married actress (Laura Smet) who shows signs of going mad.

titles.title: The Grocer's Son
titles.plot: A young man returns to his village to help his father.

titles.title: Gulmohar
titles.plot: Following the multi-generation Batra family, who are all set to move out of their 34-year-old family home, and how this shift in their lives is a rediscovery of the bonds that have held them together as a family with secrets and insecurities.

titles.title: Hadewijch
titles.plot: A troubled young woman is thrown out of a convent and forms a relationship with a radical Muslim.

titles.title: He Was a Quiet Man
titles.plot: A frustrated office worker becomes a reluctant hero after saving a woman's life.

titles.title: Here and There
titles.plot: A man (Pedro De los Santos) returns home to Mexico after many years in the U.S. He hopes to make a better life with his family and pursue his dream of starting a band.

titles.title: His Private Secretary
titles.plot: A minister's granddaughter (Evalyn Knapp) tames a tycoon's playboy son (John Wayne).

titles.title: Inch'Allah
titles.plot: Chloe, a young Canadian doctor, lives in Israel and cares for pregnant Palestinian women in a refugee camp.

titles.title: Jack of the Red Hearts
titles.plot: Conning her way into a job as a caregiver, a teenage runaway (AnnaSophia Robb) forms a bond with an 11-year-old autistic girl (Taylor Richardson) and the child's mother (Famke Janssen).

trailer.title: Jack of the Red Hearts: Trailer 1

titles.title: Janie Jones
titles.plot: First, a fading musician (Alessandro Nivola) learns that he has a daughter (Abigail Breslin) from a long-ago tryst, then he must take the teen on tour with him when her mother checks into rehab.

titles.title: I Am Yours
titles.plot: An unhappy single mother in Norway's Pakistani expatriate community begins to ignore her young son in favor of placating a Swedish filmmaker she thinks could change her life for the better.

titles.title: Katie's Mom
titles.plot: A recent divorcee's holiday celebration with her adult children derails when she falls for her daughter's charming new boyfriend.

titles.title: Luzzu
titles.plot: A hardworking Maltese fisherman, Jesmark is faced with an agonizing choice. He can repair his leaky luzzu -- a traditional, multicolored wooden fishing boat -- in the hopes of eking out a meager living at sea for his wife and newborn son, just as his father and grandfather did before him. Or he can decommission it in exchange for an EU payout and cast his lot with a sinister black-market operation that is decimating the Mediterranean fish population and the livelihoods of the local families who depend on it.

titles.title: Marfa Girl
titles.plot: A disaffected Texas teen (Adam Mediano) spends his 16th birthday getting high, hanging out and having casual sex.

titles.title: Nocturnal
titles.plot: Laurie, a cynical schoolgirl, builds a secret friendship with Pete, an older man who is obsessed with her.

titles.title: O.G.
titles.plot: Louis Menkins is in the final weeks of his 24-year prison sentence. Though he doesn't talk about it, Louis' nervousness about adapting to life on the outside is affecting every decision he makes. Chief among those is his choice to befriend a new prisoner named Tracy Beecher, who is facing 23 years for murder. Louis warns Tracy to stay away from gang life, but it soon becomes clear that such a feat is easier said than done.

titles.title: One Second
titles.plot: A movie fan strikes up a relationship with a homeless female vagabond.

titles.title: Private Property
titles.plot: Pascale (Isabelle Huppert) leads a lonely life with her adult sons François (Yannick Rénier) and Thierry (Jérémie Renier) at a rural estate subsidized by her ex-husband's alimony payments. When Pascale falls for neighbor Jan (Kris Cuppens), she makes plans to move in with him. But Pascale's twin sons -- loafers who treat her like a servant and refuse to accept the responsibilities of adulthood -- won't let her go. The family remains locked in a stalemate until someone makes a startling move.

titles.title: Promises
titles.plot: Clémence, the fearless mayor of a town near Paris, is completing the final term of her political career. With her faithful right-hand man Yazid, she has long fought for this town plagued by poverty, unemployment and slumlords. However, when Clémence is approached to become Minister, her ambition arises, questioning her devotion and commitment to her citizens. Will her political integrity and election promises survive her newly found ambition?

titles.title: Silver Haze
titles.plot: 23-year-old Franky is a nurse who lives with her large family in an East London borough. Obsessed with a thirst for revenge and a need to assign guilt for a traumatic event that happened 15 years before, she is unable to build any meaningful relationship until she falls in love with one of her patients – Florence. They escape to the coast where Florence lives with her more open-minded patchwork family. There, Franky finds the emotional shelter to deal with the grudges of the past.

titles.title: Sonne
titles.plot: Three teenage girls from Vienna twerk in hijab and sing a pop song. A YouTube video of it makes them famous overnight, especially among Kurdish Muslims. Yesmin, the only one of the friends who is Kurdish herself, begins to distance herself more and more from her culture. Nati and Bella, on the other hand, seem fascinated by a world that is strange to them. When the girls meet two young Kurdish patriots, the situation threatens to escalate. A film about young people caught between social media and self-discovery, a story of rebellious young women.

titles.title: Sprinter
titles.plot: A Jamaican teen who is burdened by an unstable father and an unruly older brother hopes a meteoric rise in track-and-field can reunite him with his mother, who has lived illegally in the U.S. for over a decade.

titles.title: The Club
titles.plot: Living in exile in La Boca, Chile, four disgraced priests and a nun receive a visit from a clerical counselor.

images.caption: Roberto Farías as Sandokan in "The Club."

titles.title: The Cold Lands
titles.plot: After his self-reliant mother dies unexpectedly, a boy (Silas Yelich) flees into the woods in shock. His nerves worn thin, he encounters a drifter (Peter Scanavino) and forms a wary alliance with the man.

titles.title: The End of Love
titles.plot: A young man bonds with his infant son after the child's mother dies.

images.caption: (L-R) Isaac Love as Issac and Mark Webber as Mark in "The End of Love."
Mark Webber as Mark in "The End of Love."
Shannyn Sossamon as Lydia in "The End of Love."

titles.title: The Kindergarten Teacher
titles.plot: A teacher sees such great promise in her 5-year-old student that she goes to unreasonable lengths to protect his talent.

titles.title: The Noise of Engines
titles.plot: Alexandre, an instructor at the Canadian customs college, returns home to his small town after his employer places him on compulsory leave. As he forms a new friendship with a female Icelandic drag racer, he finds himself under surveillance by police investigators trying to get to the bottom of the sexually explicit drawings that have been troubling the town.

titles.title: The Patience Stone
titles.plot: In a war-torn Muslim country, a woman (Golshifteh Farahani) alleviates her silent suffering by confessing her dreams, desires and secrets to her comatose husband.

images.caption: Golshifteh Farahani as the Woman in "The Patience Stone."

titles.title: The Substitute
titles.plot: A highbrow literature professor returns to his old neighborhood to teach high school, facing his past, his father and the reality of his community.

titles.title: The Trouble With the Truth
titles.plot: After their daughter announces her engagement, two former spouses (Lea Thompson, John Shea) have a reunion dinner and discover that a sexual spark still smolders between them.

titles.title: All the Wilderness
titles.plot: A new friend (Evan Ross) and a new love interest (Isabelle Fuhrman) help a teen (Kodi Smit-McPhee) come to grips with the death of his father.

titles.title: Toni
titles.plot: Toni (Charles Blavette) is an Italian immigrant trying to make it in the melting pot of 1920s Provence, France. He moves in with his landlady, Marie (Jenny Helia), and gets a job as a laborer at a quarry. Any stability he has is threatened when he falls for the Spanish Josefa (Celia Montalvan), a young woman who marries the brutish quarry foreman, Albert (Max Dalban), after he rapes her. When Toni tries to save Josefa from her miserable existence, he must face the tragic consequences.

titles.title: Tony Manero
titles.plot: On weekends, 50-something Raul Peralta goes to the same bar outside his native Santiago, Chile, and, with friends, dances to the hits from his favorite film, "Saturday Night Fever." When he gets wind of a TV contest seeking the best imitation of Tony Manero, the main character from the film, he becomes fixated on winning. But as Raul becomes involved in nefarious activities -- including murder -- to complete his Tony Manero transition, he puts his friends and himself at risk.

titles.title: Urok
titles.plot: A hard-working teacher in a small Bulgarian town is driven to desperate measures to avoid financial ruin.

titles.title: What Will People Say
titles.plot: Sixteen-year-old Nisha lives a double life. When out with her friends, she's a regular Norwegian teenager. At home with her family, she is the perfect Pakistani daughter. When her father catches her alone with her boyfriend, Nisha's two worlds brutally collide. To set an example and escape the judgment of their peers, Nisha's parents send her to live with her extended family in a small town in Pakistan. There, Nisha must adapt to a rigid culture that denies her the freedoms she once enjoyed.
